tasks.intent: A typed enum already excludes invalid build states; JSON from a remote client is untrusted. A) Test every enum variant redundantly. B) Parse the JSON once at the boundary and test malformed and accepted external inputs. C) Trust the static type to validate network bytes. Return only A, B, or C.
